conventions.field: K=Q(rho), rho^2=2; E:y^2=x^3-Dx, D=11-6rho=(3-rho)^2; P=2R0, R0=(1+rho,2rho).
conventions.coefficients: F_s denotes the rational rho coefficient of f([s]P), while X_n is the rho coefficient of x([n]P). They are different functions. Physical X_A=2*v83, X_T=2*v87, X_Z=2*v89; F_s=2*g0*g1.
conventions.valuations: At consumed p>76176 use integral unramified normalization. At3 the quadratic field is inert and the curve has good reduction. At2 use v(2)=1, v(rho)=1/2 and the integral formal subgroup, not good reduction.
conventions.localDomain: The new contact argument uses required positive odd alpha=v_p(F5(A*lambda)), with1+R a unit. A radical-free detector has no asserted global trace inverse.
conventions.fixedConstant: C=3^(2^25) is a fixed integer coefficient, not a rational variable in symbolic candidates.
conventions.height: Same three positive rational square scales1,C0^2,(1+C1^2)^2, exponent19 height constant Hcal and root-height transfer Bmax^2-6<7Hcal*|N|^(19/k).
conventions.logarithms: Same rational N/Q high evaluator at order40 and same G2 shallow evaluator with actual precision12. Tests require middle order10; completeness for326 consumes the stronger actual precision12.
conventions.provenance: All author/reviewer identities here are identities recorded in the cited internal reports. No provider attestation or new independent approval is asserted.

revision4ArithmeticInputs.classification: Inherited pre-H Kummer periods and trace/pole theorem. Distinct residue classes and lower bounds are proved internally; no new external theorem.

proof.heading: ## Recovering H depth without the old high H0 test

revision4ArithmeticInputs.classification: Retained simultaneous-prime theorem and real-progression lemma. CRT prescription, coefficient estimates and parity calculation are internal.
Polynomial identity over Q(rho), rho^2=2. No external theorem or new completeness choice.
Exact rational algebra, integer exponent induction and full finite tables only.
Laurent reconstruction under an explicit inverse. No new external theorem; new forward existence is N30..N33.

Retained formal-subgroup finite-index/real-progression application and odd-root coefficient lemma. The local formulas are proved internally. The usual Q2 and odd-Qp unit-square criteria are standard external lemmas invoked without reproving them; no new global arithmetic theorem is introduced.

Same simultaneous-prime theorem with enlarged fixed exclusions. Norm surjectivity is deduced internally from the standard cyclicity theorem for finite-field multiplicative groups. Cyclicity and one-variable Hensel lifting are invoked standard external lemmas, not proved in the note and not stronger prime-pattern assumptions.

Reuses the same quaternion representation theorem once for a basepoint. Reflection identity, local density reduction and coordinatewise approximation construction are proved internally; standard CRT and the local square-root-near1 lemma are invoked without reproof. No external weak-approximation theorem for quadrics is invoked.
Same prime-selection, real-progression, preparation-zero and pole results with newly checked inputs. No self-approval of the contributed proof.
